performance.profileReason1: Inline arrow function props passed to children (onAddToCart={() => ...})
performance.profileReason2: Unmemoized Redux selector creating new object reference on every dispatch
performance.profileReason3: Dynamic style object created in render body ({ marginTop: insets.top + 10 })
performance.profileReason4: FlatList missing getItemLayout causing async layout measuring passes
performance.profileReason5: renderItem function defined anonymously inside JSX body
performance.profileReason6: List item components not wrapped with React.memo
performance.profileReason7: Parent screen re-rendered on keyboard show/hide event
performance.profileReason8: Unstable callback reference passed into checkout button
performance.profileReason9: TextInput value state triggers parent re-render on every keystroke without debouncing
performance.profileReason10: Passing unmemoized filter object ({ category, minPrice }) down to child chips
performance.profileReason11: Avatar image cache re-validation on auth session refresh
performance.fixUseCallbackDesc: Inline functions recreate a new memory reference on every render, invalidating React.memo on child components.
performance.fixCreateSelectorTitle: Memoize Redux / Zustand Selectors with shallowEqual
performance.fixCreateSelectorDesc: Returning new object or array references inside useSelector forces an automatic re-render on every state dispatch.
performance.fixUseMemoStylesTitle: Hoist Styles or Use useMemo for Dynamic Dimensions
performance.fixUseMemoStylesDesc: Inline style objects create new object identities on every frame pass, causing Yoga Flexbox reconciliation diffs.
performance.fixGetItemLayoutDesc: Supplying getItemLayout allows FlatList to immediately compute scroll offsets and virtual windows without measuring views asynchronously.
performance.fixReactMemoDesc: Prevents all 50+ visible list items from re-rendering when parent list state (e.g. scroll position or pagination) updates.
performance.fixComponentSplittingTitle: Isolate Fast-Changing State in Leaf Components
performance.fixComponentSplittingDesc: Move keyboard listeners and modal animation state into self-contained subcomponents so the parent does not re-render.
performance.fixDebouncedInputTitle: Debounce Search Input or Use Local Controlled State
performance.fixDebouncedInputDesc: Do not propagate keystroke state into global store immediately. Use a 250ms debounce or uncontrolled ref.
performance.fixPrimitivePropsTitle: Pass Primitive Props Instead of Large Objects
performance.fixPrimitivePropsDesc: Passing only categoryId string instead of whole category object prevents re-renders when other category metadata updates.
performance.fixUseRefForTrackingTitle: Use useRef for Non-Visual Tracking Values
performance.fixUseRefForTrackingDesc: Do not store analytics timers, scroll offsets, or tracking IDs in useState if they do not directly alter the JSX tree.

performance.beforeCreateSelector: // ❌ Before in <{{comp}} /> (returns new object reference every render):

performance.afterMemo: // ✅ After (skips render if props are shallowly identical):

performance.fixInteractionManagerDesc: Heavy data processing during screen animations drops frames. Defer until transition finishes.
performance.fixFlatListWindowingDesc: Configure maxToRenderPerBatch and windowSize to minimize offscreen virtualized view allocations.
performance.fixImageCachingDesc: Use priority headers or resizeMode downscaling to avoid massive bitmap allocations in the Hermes heap.
performance.fixContextSplittingTitle: Split Monolithic Context into Granular Providers
performance.fixContextSplittingDesc: Components subscribing to a large context re-render even when unused state properties change.

performance.transitionEventAdvice: Interaction completed within 60 FPS target budget.
performance.heavyTaskEventDetail: JS thread blocked for {{duration}}ms during task execution.
performance.heavyTaskEventAdvice: Consider offloading to web worker, InteractionManager, or batching in chunks.
performance.renderLoopWarningDetail: Component re-rendered {{count}} times in 500ms. Potential infinite loop or unstable dependencies.
performance.renderLoopWarningAdvice: Check useEffect / useCallback dependency arrays for unstable object or function references.
performance.event1Detail: Screen transition triggered heavy layout reconciliation and simultaneous component mounts.
performance.event1Advice: Defer non-critical offscreen hooks with InteractionManager.runAfterInteractions to preserve 60 FPS.
performance.event2Detail: FlatList rendered 25 items simultaneously on orientation change without memoized row component.
performance.event2Advice: Implement getItemLayout and React.memo(LogCard) to skip redundant diffing passes.
performance.event3Detail: Hardware accelerated native driver animated transform running smoothly at sustained 60 FPS.
performance.event3Advice: Using nativeDriver: true successfully prevents JS thread blocking during animations.
performance.event4Detail: Minor generational GC cycle scavenged 4.2 MB ephemeral heap objects with sub-millisecond thread pause.
performance.event4Advice: Hermes generational garbage collector is operating within optimal sub-5ms limits.
performance.gcCycleDetail: Reclaimed ~{{amount}} MB unreferenced heap objects and compacted memory nursery.
performance.gcCycleAdvice: Heap usage optimized. Generational nursery cleared.
performance.liveFpsDropDetail: Main thread frame duration extended to {{duration}}ms during view update.
performance.liveFpsDropAdvice: Heavy JavaScript execution during frame pass delayed display presentation.
performance.event5Detail: 50-item API response parse overhead in network adapter (185 KB JSON raw string).
performance.event5Advice: Consider paginating API payloads or streaming responses if payload size exceeds 250 KB.
performance.event6Detail: Retina raster decode for banner_dark.png (1200×630px raster buffer allocation).
performance.event6Advice: Downscale asset dimensions or convert to WebP to reduce decode latency by ~65%.
performance.event7Detail: AsyncStorage / MMKV preferences transaction read across 32 configuration keys.
performance.event7Advice: Direct C++ JSI Turbomodule bindings completely bypass legacy JSON bridge serialization overhead.
performance.event8Detail: Redux dispatch pass evaluated 6 reducer slices and emitted state notification in 4.8ms.
performance.event8Advice: State tree immutability preserved. Memoized selectors prevented redundant component renders.
performance.event9Detail: Gesture responder dispatched tap event to TabBar button with immediate 60 FPS response.
performance.event9Advice: Touch responder latency is well within standard 16.67ms frame budget.
performance.event10Detail: Inspector UI multi-tab card layout recalculation and font metrics pass in C++ Yoga engine.
performance.event10Advice: Flexbox layout constraints are cached and computed efficiently with zero reflow penalties.

bundle.optTip1Title: Convert Heavy PNGs to WebP / SVGs
bundle.optTip1Desc: Images account for >40% of final app download size. Converting 2x/3x raster PNGs to WebP saves 60-70% size with no visible fidelity loss.
bundle.optTip2DescActive: Hermes is active! JavaScript is compiled into optimized bytecode Ahead-Of-Time.
bundle.optTip2DescInactive: Hermes is disabled. Enable hermes in your app config for ~40% smaller payload and instant TTI startup.
bundle.optTip3Desc: Include only the font weights you actively use (e.g. Regular & Bold). Remove unused glyph ranges to save 100KB+ per font file.
bundle.optTip4Desc: Import from specific subpaths (e.g. lodash/get or specific vector icon sets) instead of importing large monolithic packages.
bundle.optTip5Desc: Lazy load secondary screens and heavy modal sheets using dynamic imports and InteractionManager to reduce initial bundle evaluation.
